articles.title: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation
articles.executive_summary: Two unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances are being actively exploited, allowing remote code execution. Citrix has not confirmed the flaws or published a fix, prompting some administrators to take appliances offline.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerabilities allow remote code execution through unspecified attack vectors, with Citrix appliances being taken offline to prevent exploitation. The root cause of the issue is the presence of unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances.
actionable_mitigations: Take Citrix appliances offline until a patch is available
Implement network segmentation and isolation
Monitor for suspicious activity and implement detection and log monitoring indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Two unpatched Citrix NetScaler zero-day vulnerabilities are being actively exploited, allowing remote code execution. Citrix has not confirmed the flaws or published a fix, prompting some administrators to take appliances offline.

articles.title: ShinyHunters uses WAF bypass trick in Oracle PeopleSoft attacks
articles.executive_summary: ShinyHunters is exploiting the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw by bypassing web application firewall rules using a URL-encoding trick, allowing them to compromise vulnerable servers. This attack poses a significant operational risk to organizations that have not patched the vulnerability.
articles.technical_breakdown: The ShinyHunters gang is using a URL-encoding trick to bypass WAF rules, allowing them to exploit the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw. This trick enables the threat actors to evade detection and compromise vulnerable servers.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the patch for CVE-2026-35273 to Oracle PeopleSoft servers
Implement URL-encoding filtering on WAF rules
Monitor for suspicious activity and log anomalies related to the CVE-2026-35273 flaw
articles.telegram_snippet: ShinyHunters is exploiting the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw by bypassing WAF rules using a URL-encoding trick, posing a significant operational risk to unpatched servers.

articles.title: Lunex Stealer Abuses AMD Driver to Disable Security Monitoring and Steal Browser Credentials
articles.threat_category: Ransomware | Data Breach | 0-Day & Exploit | Nation-State/APT | Cloud & Supply Chain | Vulnerability / Advisory
articles.executive_summary: The Lunex Stealer malware is abusing AMD drivers to disable security monitoring and steal browser credentials from Ukrainian-speaking users. This is part of a four-stage attack chain distributed via compromised Ukrainian websites.
articles.technical_breakdown: The attack chain begins with a fake CAPTCHA page and uses ClickFix-style Cloudflare verification checks to distribute the Psychedelic Stealer malware. The malware then abuses AMD drivers to disable security monitoring and steal browser credentials.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure AMD drivers are up-to-date and patched
Implement network containment or firewall rules to block suspicious traffic
Monitor for detection and log monitoring indicators related to the Lunex Stealer malware
articles.telegram_snippet: Lunex Stealer malware abuses AMD drivers to disable security monitoring and steal browser credentials from Ukrainian-speaking users via compromised websites.

articles.title: Attackers Bypass WAFs to Exploit Oracle PeopleSoft Flaw and Deploy Web Shells
articles.executive_summary: Attackers are exploiting a critical security vulnerability in Oracle PeopleSoft to deploy web shells, bypassing WAFs and targeting multiple sectors globally. This campaign involves the weaponization of CVE-2026-35273, a zero-day vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.8.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability allows for unauthenticated remote code execution, enabling attackers to deploy web shells and gain unauthorized access to systems. The exploit is being used to target multiple sectors globally, with WAFs being bypassed to facilitate the attack.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the patch for CVE-2026-35273 as soon as possible
Implement network containment and firewall rules to block suspicious traffic
Monitor logs and detection systems for indicators of the exploit
articles.telegram_snippet: ShinyHunters-linked attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-35273 in Oracle PeopleSoft to deploy web shells, targeting multiple sectors globally with a CVSS score of 9.8.

articles.title: New x47.c Windows Botnet Weaponizes xAI Grok, AI API Draining
articles.executive_summary: A new Windows botnet leverages AI to maintain persistence, using xAI Grok to choose from predefined actions, posing a significant threat to enterprise networks. The botnet's AI-driven approach makes it challenging to detect and mitigate.
articles.technical_breakdown: The botnet relies on xAI Grok, an AI API, to select from predefined actions, allowing it to adapt and evade detection. This AI-driven approach enables the botnet to maintain persistence and evade traditional security measures.
actionable_mitigations: Implement xAI Grok API restrictions and access controls
Monitor network traffic for suspicious AI-driven activity
Implement AI-powered threat detection and response tools
articles.telegram_snippet: New Windows botnet uses AI to maintain persistence, posing a significant threat to enterprise networks. AI-driven approach makes detection and mitigation challenging.

articles.title: Claude Opus 5.5 uses 95% fewer em dashes, but its answers are getting longer
articles.executive_summary: Claude Opus 5.5 uses 95% fewer em dashes, but its answers are getting longer. Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 appears to be changing how it writes, with new analysis showing fewer obvious AI writing patterns, shorter sentences, and simpler wording compared with Opus 5.

articles.title: OpenAI's AI Agents Accidentally Upload User-Provided Images to Third-Party Sites
articles.executive_summary: OpenAI's AI agents inadvertently uploaded user-provided images to third-party image-hosting services, potentially exposing sensitive data. This incident highlights the risks of AI systems interacting with external services without proper controls.
articles.technical_breakdown: The AI agents were designed to carry out research and evaluation tasks, which involved uploading images to third-party services for processing. However, the agents did not have adequate controls to prevent the upload of sensitive data.
actionable_mitigations: Review and update AI system configurations to prevent unauthorized data uploads
Implement additional controls to ensure sensitive data is not shared with third-party services
Monitor AI system logs for suspicious activity
articles.telegram_snippet: OpenAI's AI agents accidentally uploaded user-provided images to third-party sites, potentially exposing sensitive data. Incident highlights risks of AI systems interacting with external services without proper controls.

articles.title: US and China Agree to Establish AI Safety Channel
articles.executive_summary: The US and China have agreed to establish a communication mechanism for AI-related incidents, aiming to prevent potential security risks. This move is part of ongoing trade and military talks between the two nations.
articles.technical_breakdown: The AI safety channel will serve as a platform for the US and China to share information and coordinate responses to potential AI-related security incidents. This initiative is expected to enhance cooperation and trust between the two nations.
actionable_mitigations: Monitor AI-related security updates and advisories from both US and Chinese authorities
Implement robust incident response plans for AI-related security incidents
articles.telegram_snippet: US and China agree to establish AI safety channel to prevent potential AI-related security risks, as part of ongoing trade and military talks.
